role_and_message.evidence: The full benchmark construction and four-stage urban-diagnosis workflow remain the organizing message.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Atomic/workflow taxonomy, imagery/raster/vector data groups, agentic Thought-Action-Observation environment and all four analytical stages remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Five atomic task names, LST/NTL/Landcover/Built/POP, Road Network/POI/AOI, S1-S4 stage names and all analysis/check/refine/diagnosis labels retain their meanings.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Query plus data flows through framing and analysis plan, environment/profile evidence, overlay and spatial/qualitative evidence, then check/refine/diagnosis. Dashed revision returns from refine-claim to reasoning agent; tool/code paths feed observations.

visual_encodings.evidence: Green construction and orange workflow groups remain distinct, blue planning/checking nodes preserve identities, and original geographic evidence colors are unchanged.

examples_and_data.evidence: All six satellite/street/LST/landcover/spatial-support/qualitative-support image tiles independently match original native1x RGB pixels and recorded hashes.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Rearranged labels and more explicit row alignment restate original task taxonomy and workflow described on source pages2-3; no new task, data modality or performance claim is added.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All construction components, four workflow stages, six restored evidence tiles and revision connector remain complete and visible.

remaining_limitations: Exact original source regions are preserved at native or integer nearest scale; enlarged small labels retain original pixel detail. Fidelity audit does not independently validate scientific conclusions.

Figure 1: Overview of DUDA-Bench. The benchmark connects a hierarchical task taxonomy and
multimodal urban case dataset with an interactive agent environment, and formulates urban diagno-
sis as a four-stage analytical workflow.
